growth.feedback.outcome-native-verify: Grounded Growth Outcomes verifies its own receipts, but no feedback adapter requires that verification before creating an evolution need.
growth.feedback.need-map: Verified nextEvidenceNeeds are not translated into bounded improvement-need candidates.
growth.feedback.blocked-order: No seam prevents beneficiary tests from being proposed ahead of evidence repair, regression repair, refresh, or lifecycle holds.
growth.feedback.route-state-bind: Operational readiness, voluntary participation, in-progress work, and satisfied routes cannot be bound to outcome-derived needs.
growth.feedback.gei-compatible: Grounded Evolution Intelligence accepts evidence and improvement needs, but Grounded Growth emits neither native GEI record shape.
growth.feedback.deduplicate: No exact need identity or explicit coverage link prevents repeated outcome generations from proposing duplicate work.
growth.feedback.authority.none: Both source systems refuse autonomous execution, merge, promotion and CANON authority.

growth.feedback.current-review: No current feedback packet has been generated or reviewed by a steward.
